name: Hold Monster

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature you can see within range

summary: A creature makes a Wis save or is Paralyzed; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
text: A success on a repeated save ends the spell on that creature. You can target one more creature for each slot level above 5.
